KEN.note: The document is about vetting of ID applicants and states no authentication service.
Birth certificates are mentioned only as a further barrier; no link between civil register and ID is stated.
No count or share of people holding the national ID is given.
No identity number at birth is mentioned.
The document says nothing on who operates or maintains the ID system.
No public register keyed on the national ID is mentioned.
The document covers access to the national ID card and states nothing on the system's issuance, biometrics or certification.
